card.name: Notes and instructions in web text
card.fires_on: Small words and punctuation inside notices, disclaimers and calls to action on web pages, such as 'not included as part of', 'Do not use', 'contact us' or 'If you decide'. It also fires on a digit inside a long URL.

modes.label: Disclaimer wording
modes.description: Words within a note saying what is not included or must not be done with the material.
modes.example: Note: CD-ROM/DVD and other supplementary materials are not<< included>> as part of eBook file.

modes.label: Call to action
modes.description: A linking word or comma right before an invitation to contact, subscribe or enter a code.
modes.example: Don’t worry you still can be a part of the programme we are currently looking for NCS Brand Ambassadors<< contact>> us for more information.

modes.label: Digit in a URL
modes.description: A digit partway through a long web address.

card.writes: It lowers words meaning notice or announcement, mostly Chinese ones, so it does not add a clear output.
card.plain: It marks small words inside fine-print notes and calls to action on web pages.
